items.statement: The submission defines and applies a finite candidate-generation and deduplication procedure for each of the six named complexes.
items.expected_result: Each system has candidate identities, search count, deduplication rationale and coverage/stopping evidence.
items.expected: Each system has candidate identities, search count, deduplication rationale and coverage/stopping evidence.

items.statement: Complex and isolated-fragment calculations are converged and the selected structure is independently checked.
items.expected_result: SCF/geometry convergence evidence and an independent-start or sensitivity validation are reported per system.
items.expected: SCF/geometry convergence evidence and an independent-start or sensitivity validation are reported per system.

items.statement: The six binding energies are the reported molecular-complex observables.
items.expected_result: Values are supplied for SnI2-FAI, SnI2-HDC, SnI2-HDC-DMSO, PbI2-FAI, PbI2-HDC and PbI2-HDC-DMSO using the declared convention and eV units.
items.expected: Values are supplied for SnI2-FAI, SnI2-HDC, SnI2-HDC-DMSO, PbI2-FAI, PbI2-HDC and PbI2-HDC-DMSO using the declared convention and eV units.

items.statement: HDC-containing association is selectively stronger for Sn than Pb, most clearly for the HDC-DMSO package.
items.expected_result: The conclusion compares matched ligand packages across metals and respects more-negative-as-stronger convention.
items.expected: The conclusion compares matched ligand packages across metals and respects more-negative-as-stronger convention.
